scope: 2023-Q1 through 2026-Q3; ten series; nonexhaustive release universe

method.original_comparator_method: Each period with at least two dated vintages has equal weight. Compare its first archived value with its latest. Absolute revisions include unchanged periods. A sign crossing changes the sign category (negative, zero, positive). A threshold crossing changes the truth of value < threshold. Thresholds are illustrative briefing cutoffs in the original unit. Ever-revised counts any change between releases, including changes later reversed.
method.equal_weight: One eligible period one vote per series, including unchanged periods. No pooled series denominator. At least two DISTINCT dated publication dates for main comparator. Repeated same-date equal cells do not add weight; conflicts excluded.
method.strict_first: Only explicit target-quarter advance release evidence is confirmed original first. Labour original-quarter timing proxy is NOT confirmation; no strict-first employment estimates possible from retained evidence.
method.snapshot: Undated current API is observation on 2026-11-19, not dated publication. Main snapshot sensitivity retains two-dated denominator; expanded sensitivity allows one dated plus snapshot and labels changed denominator.
method.units: Growth and unemployment revisions in percentage points; employment in persons. QoQ growth SA nonannualized. Employment includes MDWs; unemployment overall SA quarter-end.
method.crossings: Sign categories negative/zero/positive; threshold crossing changes truth of value < threshold, equality belongs to not-below. Requested GDP 0,2,3; unemployment 2; original illustrative thresholds retained for all series.
method.precision: Decimal input differences; unrounded JSON statistics; shares 0..1; empty denominator null. Ever revised counts changes among retained sequence, not all releases.
method.latest: Latest verified dated publication available in this partial collection, not proof of latest agency restatement. No future release inferred.
